messages.subject: mqmaugment running forever
parts:
Hello Karl/group,

I'm in the process of using mqm in a dataset of 148 RILs and 1581 markers.

I can't get through this mqmaugment step:

Ben.aug <- mqmaugment(Ben.map, maxaugind=82, minprob=1.0, strategy="default",verbose=TRUE)

Any ideas why I'm getting stuck? I only see the first four INFO statements look (which look normal) but I'm not getting past that.

Any advice would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Jeff

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] mqmaugment running forever
parts:
I don't think mqm augment is going to work for you. it's trying to expand the lines to fill in missing genotypes in all possible ways. probably best to use fill.geno and just impute missing data. 

karl
